verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency is a fair question for a domain registrar, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack makes an at-cost or near-wholesale claim, shows a registry fee breakdown, or publishes a low-margin guarantee. The reseller program's control over the prices shown to customers is a related but different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power user, pricing is at or near wholesale — at-cost claims backed by visible registry fee breakdowns or a published low-margin guarantee
